title: List Services
description: Lists all Cloud Run services in a given project and location.

objective.narrative: This sample demonstrates how to list services using the `listServicesAsync` method, which returns an asynchronous iterable. This approach is efficient for handling large numbers of services as it processes them one by one, avoiding loading all results into memory at once.
